Description:
Ballistics of the 105x617mm M735 APFSDS-T fired from the M68 tank gun.

Tube length is 5346mm, projectile travel 4770mm. Chamber volume is 6.47L. Loads 5.67kg of M30 grains with TiO2 wear reduction agent. Projectile weighs 5.82 kg. Develops 1501 m/s at 415 MPa.

Note that PIBS additionally corrects for chambrage, so exact reproduction of IBHVG2 results require additional fitting. 

References:
- STANAG 4458 105mm ammunition for rifled tank guns
- TM 43-0001-28 Army Ammunition Data Sheets for Artillery Ammunition: Guns, Howitzers, Mortars, Recoilless Rifles, Grenade Launchers and Artillery Fuzes
- "105mm Enhanced Gun" (1983) US Army Armor Center Headquarters, Fort Knox
